answer: The bridge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The tide is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the lotus. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
